blocks.title: Quality tooling: linting, formatting, prek pre-commit hook, test runner setup, basic CI, container execution
Server logging: logger and request logging, pretty in dev and JSON in production

consultations.question: Are the functional goals and problems for ticket 2 (Linting, logging and tests) understood correctly, and is scope (client/server, CI, formatter) as assumed?
options: Understood as stated, scope: client + server, no CI
consultations.answer: Understood; scope is client + server. Add a formatter and a very basic CI. Continue.

consultations.question: Is the split into two theme blocks (quality tooling; server logging) right, or should this be one block?
options: One block for the whole ticket
Three blocks: lint/format/prek, tests, logging, with CI attached to one
consultations.answer: Two blocks as proposed. Added constraint: work happens outside the container, so all tooling must be installed in the Docker container and run from the host via docker or docker compose.

consultations.question: Does knowledge.md (goals, problems, open questions, incl. the new container-execution goal) capture ticket 2 correctly?

Which options for b1: container runner (compose/devcontainer CLI/docker run), node_modules (named volume/bind mount), prek hook (run vs exec wrapper), CI (native vs container), Vitest layout (projects vs per-package), oxfmt pinned?
options: Recommended set: docker compose, named volumes, prek hook via run --rm -T wrapper, native CI, Vitest projects, oxfmt pinned exact
consultations.answer: docker compose, combined with a Dockerfile that installs prek and the other tooling. prek is installed in the container and run from the host via `docker compose exec <service> prek ...`. Format hook: check only. Rest of recommended set as proposed.

consultations.question: Which options for b2: hand-written Hono middleware on shared pino vs hono-pino, in-process pino-pretty gated by NODE_ENV vs pipe, c.get('logger') only vs AsyncLocalStorage?
options: Recommended set: hand-written middleware + hono/request-id, in-process pino-pretty by NODE_ENV, c.get('logger') only, no header logging plus redact backstop

consultations.question: Are the LikeC4 diff and the logging stubs (b2), and the container-execution design (b1, ADR 0003), the right contract to implement against? Open sub-question: when the container is not running at commit time, should the hook fail with a clear message or start the container itself?
options: Approve as presented; hook fails with a clear message (Recommended)
Approve; hook starts the container with `docker compose up -d`
consultations.answer: Approved as presented. Hook: prek runs in the container, so nothing can run while it is stopped; host hook script aborts with a clear message (default, developer did not choose auto-start).
